item.title: Brock Purdy misses practice as 49ers prepare to face desperate Seahawks
item.description:
On this episode of “49ers Talk,” co-hosts Matt Maiocco and Jennifer Lee Chan discuss how San Francisco can overcome the mental and physical toll of their Week 11 win over the Vikings in Mexico City. Despite the 49ers rolling in the NFC, San Francisco can’t overlook a desperate Seahawks team in Week 12, who still boast a vaunted defense themselves as the defending Super Bowl champions. Later, the duo discuss John Lynch’s contract extension as well as the end of the Brandon Aiyuk saga.

--

(0:00) 49ers return from Mexico City with major implications on the line in Week 12
(3:00) Purdy pops up on injury report (ankle), did not practice Wednesday
(6:00) Weather will be an issue this weekend at Levi’s
(8:00) 49ers extend John Lynch’s contract
(15:00) 49ers injury updates, other roster moves
(21:00) It’s official: Brandon Aiyuk has no more connection to the 49ers contractually

item.title: 49ers send message to NFL with prime-time magic in Mexico City
item.description:
On this episode of “49ers Talk,” co-hosts Matt Maiocco and Jennifer Lee Chan discuss San Francisco’s impressive Week 11 performance over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday night in Mexico City. All three phases played complementary football, with Brock Purdy looking calm and collected as he spearheaded an explosive offense that stunned the league’s No. 1 defense. Jennifer and Matt also look ahead to a tricky divisional test at Levi’s Stadium against the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks, and how San Francisco’s investment against Minnesota might have left it short next week, along with the loss of 49ers starting right tackle Colton McKivitz for the season.

--

(0:00) 49ers’ international following is second-to-none in the NFL
(3:00) 49ers locked in from moment they touched down in Colorado Springs
(6:00) Colton McKivitz sustains season-ending ankle injury
(9:00) Brock Purdy looked, played part of MVP vs. Vikings
(14:00) Tough draw: 49ers dealt two international games in one season but showed grit
(18:00) Revisiting Nick Bosa’s comments about cheering fans from Mexico
(23:00) Game vs. Vikings was so huge that Week 12 opponent went overlooked

item.title: Kyle Shanahan discusses 49ers’ challenges for matchup vs. Vikings in Mexico City
item.description:
“49ers Talk” host Matt Maiocco previews San Francisco’s Week 11 game against the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday night in Mexico City. Then, Matt sits down with coach Kyle Shanahan to break down key matchups against an aggressive Brian Flores defense. Also, NBC Bay Area’s Raj Mathai stops by to analyze how pivotal the 49ers-Vikings matchup could be for playoff seeding.
--
(1:49) Matt previews 49ers’ Week 11 game vs. Vikings in Mexico City
(2:37) Injury update for Rams’ star receiver Puka Nacua
(3:19) Latest roster and injury updates ahead of 49ers-Vikings
(13:24) How Shanahan, 49ers are preparing for game vs. Vikings in Mexico City
(17:40) Shanahan discusses the challenges of Brian Flores’ aggressive defense
(27:17) Shanahan breaks down how DE Nick Bosa can bounce back from slow start
(36:19) Raj Mathai shares his first impressions of Mexico City and its rich culture
(44:30) Mathai looks ahead to 49ers-Vikings and discuss how pivotal matchup could be for playoff seeding
(47:58) Mathai shares his predictions for rest of 49ers’ 2026 season
